Yes, this is exactly what "tuck away" means to me. Archiving moved the link out of "All bookmarks" so it's not cluttering my everyday view, but it's still sitting safe in the "Archive" area — nothing lost. And the menu there offering "Restore to All bookmarks" is the important part: tucking something away has to be reversible, so I can pull it back out whenever I want. Giving Archive its own spot in the side navigation, kept apart from my labels and normal list, feels right too.

I also noticed the menu has a separate "Delete" that warns me it can't be undone — and I like that those are two clearly different things. Archiving hides a link I want to keep; deleting is the permanent "I truly don't want this anymore." Keeping them distinct, with delete asking me to confirm first, is exactly how I'd want it, so I don't accidentally throw away something I meant to just tuck aside.

This matches what I had in mind.
